purpose: Offline comparison of four fixed personal Like ranking policies on fictional, predeclared, family-labeled plan fixtures plus an unlabeled curated ranking diagnostic. This is not observed user quality or engagement uplift.

protocol.idfPopulation: Each fixture file is a separate current public source corpus; N is the number of plans in that file.
protocol.exactSeeds: One source-bound exact Like seed per listed family; each actor profile is evaluated separately. Liked seed item is omitted from candidate ranking and pair metric denominators.
protocol.ambiguous: Ambiguous predictions are excluded from strict precision/recall/FPR and counted as false in conservative precision.

formula.sharedTerms: At least two distinct shared meaningful terms.
formula.anchor: A shared token must be identity-role text (name/event title/idea title) on at least one side and non-notes text on both sides. Summary-summary overlap cannot anchor; notes cannot be the non-notes counterpart.
formula.similarity: Maximum per-seed IDF-adjusted role-weighted Jaccard × 3, capped at 3.

caveats: All fixture plans are fictional. Judgments are manually authored at the intent-family level with selected ambiguous adjacent formats; they are not independent reviewer labels or real-user evaluations.
The prior 24-plan set was evaluated before this iteration and informed the revised rule; it is included only as a validation-informed diagnostic, not a pristine test set.
The new 28-plan challenge fixture was frozen before the Variant B.03 policy lock and was not used to choose the rule or threshold.
Pairs share seed profiles and are correlated; do not treat pair counts as independent users or derive user-population confidence intervals from them.
The Spanish and cross-language sample is small and hand-authored. Zero matches can indicate lexical coverage limitations but cannot quantify a population rate.
The curated wedding ranking diagnostic is unlabeled. A score/order change is not evidence that shared_city_break is relevant or improved.
No feature-on experiment, click/install outcome, production exposure, or causal uplift is represented.
